Personally, I’ve been live trading futures markets for over two years and I’ve been through it all. If you want to speed up your journey from blowing fundeds to building a reliable, consistent and automatic edge in the market where you can rely on your entry model doing the job for you, you’re in the right place.

On top of the top notch curriculum provided in the mentorship, I also give signals (frequency depends on the volatility and market regime), daily bias callouts, daily key levels and daily reads intraday throughout the New York session and occasionally Asia/London session.
